newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Ifo business sentiment index due May 22.
newsitem.headline: German Ifo business sentiment index due May 22.

text.p: Germany's Ifo institute for economic research expects to release its business sentiment index for April on Thursday May 22, a spokeswoman for the Munich-based institute said.

The data is due to be released at 0800 GMT. As in the previous two months, Ifo will present the results of its survey among companies both as an index and a balance between positive and negative comments.
In March, the index for business sentiment in west Germany fell to 92.4 from 93.6 in February. The index for east Germany was unchanged at 94.0.
Also in March, the balance for west Germany dropped to minus 10.2 from minus 7.8, for east Germany it was unchanged at minus 12.7.
